name: node-js-demo-app
description: Node.js/TypeScript demo marketplace app for MoySklad

scripts.build:assets: node scripts/build-client-assets.mjs && mkdir -p dist && rm -rf dist/features dist/public && cp -R src/features dist/features && mkdir -p dist/public && cp -R public/assets dist/public/assets && mkdir -p dist/loyalty/iframe && cp src/loyalty/iframe/tab.ejs dist/loyalty/iframe/
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:test && npm test
scripts.clean:data: rimraf tmp/data && shx mkdir -p tmp/data && shx chmod 700 tmp/data
